name: Godot TPS Demo Controller Code
description: First-party Godot third-person shooter reference implementation covering player movement, camera, aiming, shooting, gamepad controls and production-grade scene structure. Treat code reuse separately from bundled asset reuse.

licence.notice: All code is MIT licensed. Bundled assets and music are CC-BY 3.0; licence text also notes derivative Substance Painter materials provided by GameTextures.com. Prefer code/reference reuse and independently vetted BYJTT assets unless all bundled content obligations are verified.

provenance.notes: Official Godot Engine repository and signed 4.5 release. Code and asset licensing are explicitly separated in the repository licence.

maintenance.evidence: Official repository released Godot 4.5 build 90f2e38 in October 2025 and master targets current Godot 4.x.
maintenance.notes: Pin the release/commit matching the Godot lane rather than tracking master blindly.

compatibility.notes: The demo has keyboard/mouse and gamepad controls. BYJTT-LAB-001 still requires explicit touch-control adaptation and mobile performance evidence.

risk.legalNotes: Code is MIT. Bundled assets/music carry CC-BY 3.0 attribution obligations and the licence mentions derivative source materials from GameTextures.com; do not treat the repository as uniformly MIT.
risk.securityNotes: First-party reference project with no reason to bypass normal dependency/import review.

assessment.notes: Strong first-party reference for the Godot lane, but touch input must be added and bundled content should not be adopted wholesale without separate provenance review.

evidence.notes: Official Godot TPS demo pinned to the 4.5 release commit.
Licence separates MIT code from CC-BY 3.0 assets/music and notes derivative Substance Painter materials.

publication.notes: Public evaluation must clearly distinguish code licence from bundled asset/music licences.
